Diego (AE): Prospect (FinServ-East) wants an air-gapped POC. They called out: signed USB delivery, SBOM provenance, offline cert rotation, and a documented upgrade cadence. Can we scope a 2-week run?
Renee (SE): Yes. Proposed lightweight flow: 1) Seed USB with signed operator + runtime image. 2) Deliver minibundle diffs for security patches. 3) Run an offline cert rotation exercise. Short preflight required.
Diego (AE): Their infra has only one admin allocated. What should preflight be?
Renee (SE): Preflight (short): kernel & driver checks; disk/GPU capacity; verify root CA or signing key; confirm host can run signature verification. Provide checksum & verify commands.
Omar (Ops): Chain-of-custody note: customer wants timestamped evidence. Prefer HSM-signed SBOM + timestamping. If HSM not available, we use KMS and document export controls. Recommend minibundles < 4GB for USB.
Hannah (PM): Commercially, sealed-packaging + custom signing is billable. Suggest: one-time eng prep + per-bundle signing fee. 24/7 on-call during cutover is an add-on. Will add ranges to scoping note.
Diego (AE): They asked about upgrade cadence: quarterly security patches, up to two major upgrades/year. Can we agree during POC?
Renee (SE): We can commit to quarterly security deltas for the POC window. Major upgrades twice/year ok with planned compatibility testing. Hotpatch/no-reboot is extra validation effort.
Omar (Ops): Practical runbook inclusions: verification commands, offline CSR flow, signer key rotation steps, rollback path, and timestamp guidance if NTP blocked. Give them this snippet:
```
# verify bundle signature
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify vendor_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig minibundle.tar.gz
```
sign-bot: Artifact uploaded: finserv-east-airgap-2024-11-25 (signed). Manifest + sbom attached.
Renee (SE): For security questionnaire, attach: airgap-runbook.pdf, signed-sbom.json, minibundle-manifest-example.json, offline-rotation-script.sh, and sample verification commands.
Hannah (PM): Risks to call out in SOW: third-party SCAP scans in sealed networks may add 2-4 days; time-source restrictions require agreed timestamping; requests for hotpatching add scope and schedule.
Diego (AE): Action items: Renee -> 1-page scoping + acceptance criteria; Omar -> chain-of-custody appendix + preflight checklist; Hannah -> commercial ranges and risk appendix. Need docs by EOD PT so I can share tomorrow.
Renee (SE): Acceptance criteria draft: seed install succeeds on >=1 host; signed minibundle applies and verifies; offline cert rotation executed and validated; SBOM + signed provenance delivered; runbook handed off with one walkthrough.
Omar (Ops): Also require a named customer ops contact and a test host mirroring prod. If they block external time, include TSA or embedded timestamps.
Diego (AE): Thanks team. I'll loop in legal for sealed-delivery SOW language once scoping doc is ready. :thumbsup:
